notes.title: Patch 1.2 is here!
notes.notes:
It has finally happened! Patch 1.2 is now LIVE, and Azar is ready to face you in the arena.
We know it has been a while since the last patch and we were quiet, that because we were busy working on Azar and the other features of patch 1.2 alongside other back-stage things.
We will soon post an update on future plans.

Patch 1.2 Content
Azar boss battle
This foul creature was summoned by Ayziz's dark power straight from the fiery pits of hell.
Known for his minion summoning abilities and his sensitivity regarding his personal space.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28585376/ea6f5d3c3c24056ba8a0e96ccea15b99139f81aa.png
Azar has the following skills:

 Disarm Immunity - Azar is immune to the "Disarm" skill.
 Proximity Burst - Every few turns, if there are any adjacent warriors, Azar will emit a strong force from his body hurting warriors and destroying tiles in the blast radius.
 Meteor Shower - Every few turns, if there are no adjacent warriors, Azar will throw meteors around and on his foes, hurting the warriors and destroying the tiles in the blast zone.
 Raise Minions - Azar will raise minions to help him eradicate his foes in battle. The more minions there is the more damage resistant he becomes.
 Healing Touch - Every minion will heal Azar at the start of their turn.
Azar will drop the following gem shards:

First victory rewards:

 Tier 1 - 10 Fire shards.
 Tier 2 - 20 Fire shards.
 Tier 3 - 50 Fire shards.
 Tier 4 - 100 Fire shards.
Daily victory rewards:

 Tier 1 - 5 Fire shards.
 Tier 2 - 10 Fire shards.
 Tier 3 - 20 Fire shards.
 Tier 4 - 40 Fire shards.
Leaderboard gem shards
From now on, the chest daily reward you receive from your leaderboard rank will grant you gem shards as well!

Sudden Death Poison
When the sudden death reached the final wave in battle, all warriors will become poisoned and will receive more damage each turn.

Controller Support
We have added basic controller support that allows you to use your controller as a mouse.
Move the cursor using the joystick, and press the A/X button as left-click and the B/O button as right-click.
And of course, we added vibration :)

United States Server
We received a lot of feedback from you about the lack of a US Server, so we added it!
You can choose your region in the options menu.

Patch notes:
New Features
 Added Azar boss battle.
 Added gem shards to leaderboard rewards.
 Added Unite States server in the regions section in the options.
 Added controller support - you can now use your controller as a mouse.
 Added another layer of security against code tampering.
 Added a new achievement - That's the evilest thing I can imagine: Kill your fallen opponent an offer after he offered the exact amount you counter-offered.
 When the sudden death reached the final wave, all warriors will become poisoned and will receive more damage each turn.

Gameplay
 Gem shards received from Boss battles will now be granted in the chest you receive.
 You will now gain or lose a 20% MMR score When fighting an AI opponent in a Brutal match, compared to a human opponent.
 Active Skills in battle will now show the correct reason they are disabled when trying to activate them.
 AI Opponents should be more reasonable when trying to haggle with them in the Mercy phase.

Bugs & Technical issues

 When the party leader leaves the party match, another player becomes the host and party leader.
 When the game disconnect while in battle, it will try to reconnect back as soon as the connection comes back.
 Fixed an issue where a Steam API AuthenticateUserTicket error would appear when entering the main menu.
 Fixed an issue where killing Dead Ned while a player is hypnotized would result in a defeat.
 Reduced the game memory usage.
 Improved the game optimization.
 Fixed minor translation issues.
 Fixed an issue where a warrior dying with Retaliate effect would result in a game de-sync
 Fixed an issue in the Single Player where the "Humiliation at its finest" would not unlock when it should.
 Fixed Rapid Shooter and Combo Attack de-sync issues.
 Fixed an issue where Combo Attack and Continuous assault being triggered together would cause a de-sync.
 Fixed an issue where your partner in boss battle would appear as an enemy.
 Fixed an issue where you could show mercy to a boss by waiting for the timer to end in the Mercy phase.
 Fixed an issue where the crowd throwing crowd buff would result in a game de-sync.

notes.title: Announcing full release date
notes.notes:
Dear Santa 🎄 

It is the time of counting days, down to Christmas - down to New Year! 🎆 
In this time of wonders, we started counting down too!
The count down to the release of Warriors: Rise to Glory!. That means we are soon exiting the Early-access.
Remember to grab the 1000 Shemekels pre-order bonus, because soon it runs out!

The planned release is on the 20th of January 2022 🗓️ Time to mark this date down.

With this, we also announce that we have another important date coming.
The 15th of December. 
Why this date?

Like announced on Steam since the start, we will finalize the price of the game to 20$. 
It was meant to be on the release of the game, but we decided we would rather start with a sale, but Steam doesn't allow sales and price changes in under 30 days in between.
So on 15.12, we will raise the price and on 20.01 we will have our release sale!

Development Update 1
Greetings mighty and blood-thirsty warriors!

First of all, in this apocalypse, we wish for all of our gamers to stay safe and keep playing video games. preferably Warriors: Rise to Glory!

Things have been quiet for a while, but it is not because we were sunbathing at the beach or playing Battle Dice all day. It is because we are working very hard to bring you the ABSOLUTELY EPIC CRAZY Online experience you ever had (No exaggeration here :) ).

We wanted to give you a sneak peek and some development updates about awesome things we are brewing here.

Multiple Warriors Arena
Lately, we unveiled the "Bloodbath" arena - a place for 4+ warriors to fight until the last man standing!
This type of arena allows for a whole new array of strategies, collaborations, and Maneuvers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28585376/507767f7a2fbbf34c63bd57f400cd680b0da8143.jpg

We are waiting to see what kind of tactics you are going to come up with!

Player's House
In the Online Multiplayer, besides upgrading your-always-dying warriors, players will also have a persistent upgradeable house.
After each battle, your house receives money and soul points based on the battle rewards.
With these, you can upgrade your house with bonuses that stay with you forever like:
 Increased damage for all weapons 
 increased armor 
 bonus starting warrior money
 bonus skills 
 attribute points for each new warrior.
The cool thing about these upgrades, they stay with you FOREVER. Unlike your warrior which you cannot get too attached to.

We will expand more about the player house in later Development updates.

Lots of new things!
There a lot of new features and content coming with the multiplayer which we will unveil in future news.
For now, we can tell you there will be:
 New skills
 New Items
 New finish animations
 New leaderboard
 New jewelry screen - where you create new gems that stay with you FOREVER!

Open-Beta release date
So you must be wondering when will all the fun will begin? So are we!

We will announce the official Open-Beta release date in the upcoming months. 
Don't miss it by following and adding the store page to your wishlist right now!

Greetings brave warriors!

We know you haven't heard from us since the release of patch 0.44 (which added controller support, shields and more).
We have been really busy working on patch 0.45. At first it was supposed to be a simple patch, but as the Gavra way - we just can't settle for small things :)

In patch 0.45, we are going to include cool new features we have been working on. The main features are:

New "Rally the crowd!" Action:
For sometime you, our players have been telling us that the crowd needs to be more involved and have heavier impact in combats.
So we listened, and added a cool new action - "Rally the crowd!"
In patch 0.45 you can command the crowd to "Boo" your opponent, throwing  bananas at him and some other stuff (we don't want to spoil yet).

So how it works? when entertaining the crowd, you gain the normal crowd excitement, and with it, crowd bars. When you reach enough bars the action is unlocked. The more crowd bars you have, the higher the action level is.

level 1 - throw bananas, lightly drain your opponent crowd excitement and lightly damage him. 
level 2 - throw bananas, medium drain your opponent crowd excitement, medium damage him and root him to his current grid for 2 turns.
level 3 - throw bananas, Heavy drain your opponent crowd excitement, Heavy damage him and stun him for 1 turn.


With this action, the crowd is more involved, and getting crowd excitement is becoming more vital. We hope you will like it!

Survival Leaderboard:
In patch 0.45 we are adding the "Survival Leaderboard" that will appear in the main menu. Whenever you finish a run in the Survival mode, your score will be uploaded to the global leaderboard. https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28585376/46840a11e462de9a55fdced85d40c6a9bcb524c6.jpg

Welcome, warriors! Sit down and relax. I said relax, guys – yeah, that includes your swords, axes, bows, and other tools of destruction, alright? Bloodthirsty Danny, would you be so kind as to move your knife away from that guy’s throat? I would prefer if you do not paint the floor of this tavern with blood, thank you very much. OK, now that everyone's civil and nice, we can start. 

We are working very hard here at Gavra Games to bring you a new update to Warriors: Rise to Glory!, and we’re happy to announce that it’s getting closer and closer. Today we want to reveal some of the new stuff included in next update. First and foremost: we are implementing gamepad controls! You will be able to play the whole game with your gamepad, so you will be able to entertain the crowds with your fighting skills while lying on the couch with a cold drink of your choice!

That’s not all, of course. We are also adding some new shields for you to buy, equip, and fight with in the arena: spiked shields, dark elf shields, Roman shields, Samurai shields, and peasant Shields. If you have ever wondered what the hell are Romans and Samurais doing in the Indiekingdom, may I remind you that the emperor Ayziz uses his magic to bring here the best warriors from different places and times? 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28585376/4de08a63845d81276cc0f4b0104d451525fa1896.png

Finally, a lot of skills will get a 3rd level you can invest in: basically, that means that you can get more powerful in more different ways. The full list of improved skills will be revealed soon. And obviously, there will also be a lot of minor fixes and changes – we will publish the full patch notes when the time comes. 

That being said, I see you guys are itchy. Looks like you can take the gladiator out of the fight but not the fight out of the gladiator. Or, well, not without cutting him in half, and that can spoil anyone’s afternoon, can’t it? Please go outside if you want to fight – Danny, what did I just tell you about your knife? You’ll have to scrub that door, yeah, you heard right! The rest of you, get the hell out of here! Remember that if you want to exchange battle tips and tricks, give ideas and suggestions for the game, or just engage with other fighters, you are invited to join us on our Discord server. Good luck in the arena!

notes.title: Patch 0.43 is here!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28585376/fbab87b7929f3a89aec7a79c0afcf3b3ef818fcf.jpg

Greetings, brave warriors! Patch 0.43 is here: the next update of Warriors: Rise to Glory! is now available, with a brand new tournament with its own boss, new weapons and armors, a higher level cap, and Korean localization among other stuff. You can check all the details about this new update below. Enjoy, and good luck in the arena!

PATCH NOTES

New Features



 New tournament with a new boss: Azar – Molded by Fire
 New achievement: Golem Breaker, unlockable by defeating Azar
 Level cap now set at level 11
 3 new weapons: the axe Apocalypse, the sword Arcane Justice, and the bow Last Whisper
 Dark Elf armors are now available for purchase starting from level 9
 Added a new title, “The Thug” 
 Chest room is now breakable! 
 You can now reset your skill points before confirming the last changes



Languages



 Korean language included 
 Added Chinese and Korean names
 Chinese translation improved



Graphics



 You can now remove all the gore and blood from the game in the Options menu
 When reaching 100% crowd excitement in the Dust Bowl arena, the crowd will throw flowers at you
 Hair looks improved 
 It is now easier to rotate the warrior in the “Character” menu
 Readability of the Soul Point tooltip improved
 UI of the Shops Menu improved
 When there is only one option in the quest menu, it will be at the center of the scroll
 Buffs in the arena will now show a tooltip when hovering them with the mouse
 When you get a bonus damage stat in battle, the damage text in tooltips will now be green-colored
 Dead Warrior in the defeat cut-scene no longer hangs in the air (he lost his wings)



Sounds



 New sound when the XP count raises
 Added click sound for language buttons



Gameplay



 Entry cost for Survival has been adjusted
 Slicing Roots now immobilize for 3 turns instead of 1
 You can now see your opponents’ walking range by hovering your mouse over them 
 Fire trap burning damage is now affected by the player’s level
 Spike trap damage has been increased
 Rest stamina is now capped per level
 Added a new step in the main tutorial explaining how to zoom in and out in battles
 Treasure Boxes now have a selling price
 Pre-Battle retreat cost formula has been changed
 You can no longer level up during a tournament, only after winning the final fight
 “Battle Rush” Skill now only applies to melee damage



Bug fixes



 Fixed issue where waiting too much to decide the fate of an opponent in a tournament fight would result in mercy fate.
 Fixed issue where the damage text in battle stats would become green when changing the Strength attribute
 Fixed text graphical error in some languages
 Fixed issue where using Dirty Shot against The Cliff would cause the game to freeze
 Fixed issue where Sleight of Hand would waste the free turn granted by On Guard!
 Fixed issue where the platform at the End Game screen would spin with the warrior
 Fixed issue where Baffling Performer wouldn’t work
 Fixed issue where pressing escape in Battle Dice after a cube has caused its effects would result in another effect
 Fixed issue where the gold price in the item tooltip was not shown
 Fixed issue where the background of the language tab is gone when quitting the options menu and returning to it
 Fixed issue where The Cliff doesn’t get stunned when Spiked Defense breaks his armor
 Fixed issue where the effect of Wounded Beast wouldn’t end even when the warrior’s health is above 40% 
 Fixed issue where continuous assault would have no icon
 Fixed issue where the Version text won’t translate when changing the game language
 Fixed issue where battle tooltips would disappear on turn end.
 Fixed issue where pressing ok the in money-offering menu would result in changing the offer amount

notes.title: Patch 0.43 Revealed!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28585376/eafb657455286889edb07955ed688395481bb07b.png

Greetings, brave warriors! E3 is always an intense week for gamers, and we hope you enjoyed the show with all its hype and excitement. We’ve been hard at work here – the mad emperor Ayziz does not wait for anyone, and he had us working really hard to get you more content so you could fight in Warriors: Rise to Glory! for his amusement and eventual death by your hands. Well, he’s likely not considering that last part – he’s mad after all, right? Anyway, we’re happy to announce that Patch 0.43 will release on June 20, and it brings some new features and content for the game! 

KOREA JOINS THE FIGHT!

We will publish the full patch notes next week, but we wanted to give you a taste of it today. First of all: Korea joins the Indiekingdom! Patch 0.43 adds Korean localization to Warriors: Rise to Glory!, and we’ve also added Chinese and Korean names, as well as improved the Chinese localization. Korean is the third language supported by Warriors after English and Chinese, and there will be more languages supported further down the road. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28585376/4ca4d74472ee92e19bc9a5008b8a48316fbb74e2.jpg

BEAT THE MIGHTY AZAR IN A NEW TOURNAMENT

That’s not all, warriors! Patch 0.43 also includes a brand new tournament with a new boss to beat: the mighty Azar, Molded by Fire. You will get a new achievement if you defeat him – but it won’t be an easy task, and to help you to achieve this goal, we have added 3 new weapons: the axe Apocalypse, the sword Arcane Justice, and the bow Last Whisper; as well as Dark Elf armors, available for purchase at level 9 and above. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28585376/2b11efb7cf0aedd6e5a6ff887f1131d28c2da090.png

Oh, and the level cap is now at level 11, so you can be more powerful than ever! There’s also a new title, The Thug, and you can now break the chest room because… well, because breaking things is fun, isn’t it? After all, you’re a warrior who kills people for other people’s amusement, not a museum caretaker! 

At the request of our community, we have also implemented the possibility of removing gore and blood from the game. Maybe it turns your stomach, or you just want to play in local multiplayer with your younger siblings. Whatever the reason, you will be able to turn all gore off in the Options menu. 

Patch 0.43 will include many other improvements, overhauls, and bug fixes. Stay tuned – and good luck in the arena!

notes.title: Patch 0.42 is finally here!
notes.notes:
Greetings, brave Warriors!

We are happy to announce that Patch 0.42 is finally here!
Among many new features added, we are proud to introduce “Survival Mode”.
In Survival Mode, you play against endless waves of enemies. The longer you survive, the better your rewards! Including a scoreboard which will be part of our global leaderboard to come.
Survival Mode was requested by our community via our community HUB! So keep writing to us,
letting us know what you would like to see in our game next.

Patch 0.42 Notes:
New Features:

Survival Mode is now available – Play against endless waves of enemies, earning more rewards the further you reach. 
New achievements from mini game “Battle Dice” are now working.
Scars are now available to make your warrior look be even more “Badass!”
New “Mercy” animation cut scene is now available. 

Gameplay:

Limit the amount of HP restored while using “Rest” action in battles to max. 20 HP.
Defeated tournament enemies will always “Accept their fate”!
ESC key in all menus now takes you back to the main menu and quits the game.
Quests will no longer appear after visiting the tavern.
Option to skip dice animation in “Battle Dice” mini game using the ESC key.
“Critical Strike” now updates your chances in the “Battle Stats” menu.
Confirm dialog when hitting “Stop” button in “Battle Dice” mini game.
“Baffling Performer” Skill now makes your enemy waste his next turn.
“Wounded Beast” Skill now works properly. 
Added a special Chinese font.

Graphics:

The tournament battle loading screen no longer displays retreat value.
Fixed a very annoying issue where armor would become “out of sync” with the warrior in the main menu.
The “Back” button in the tavern is now anchored to fit the canvas well in various different resolutions.
Fixed issue where Warriors in Hotseat mode had their eyes closed in the pre-battle menu.
Added 3 new tattoos:

“MS13” – Available
“Scary Clown” – Will be available upon unlocking future achievement.
“Zombie Warrior” – Will be available upon unlocking future achievement.

Locked tabs in the character menu are now more distinguishable.
Fixed Warrior battle avatars to match the full Warrior model.
Warrior max size is now limited.
Reset Attributes button now updates the “Battle Stats” menu.
Fixed lighting in the main menu after changing the option screen.
Main menu is now open when starting a new character.
“Battle Stats” no longer appears in the main menu.
Warriors in the Hotseat loading screen now appear on their starting side.
Technical:
Improved overall performance of the game.
Added Lighting Quality option in the options screen.
Added “Window Mode” in the options screen.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed issue where the additional turn granted by “On Guard” Skill was time-limited.
Improved distance penalty formula.
Fixed issue where the dice in “Battle Dice” mini game would cause others to flip when returning to the bank.
Fixed issue where “Spiked Defense” skill would cause both Warriors to die at the same time.

Sound:

Death music volume is now connected to the “Music volume”.
Armor break sound would play multiple times when 2 or more pieces of armor broke simultaneously. 
Fixed issue where pressing the “Shop” button would play as a double click.
Fixed volume whenever the game loads.


That’s all for now! Stay tuned for the next patch, which will include Levels 9–10 and a new tournament featuring boss “Azar – The Rock”.

notes.title: Local multiplayer now available in patch 0.41!
notes.notes:
Greetings brave warriors!

We are happy to inform you that our first major patch is now available and includes Local Multiplayer!
You can now invite your friends over, play against them and fart in their faces
(Preferbly in the game, NOT in real life!).
This is one of many features that we are going to add and we are proud to announce that local multiplayer is now available.This feature is the first milestone towards online multiplayer and matchmaking.

Patch 0.41 notes:

New Features:

Hotseat mode is now available – annihilate your friends in local multi player. Choose your warrior from a selection of 6 warriors:

Tayego - The Apprentice: A balanced warrior majored in all attributes. 
Gundahar - The Barbarian: Master of dodging attacks.
Thymerius - The Roman: With so much HP, he can endure many blows. A true tanker!
Ikuzashi - The Samurai: Master of archery and can cover a lot of ground.
Nightshade - The Shinobi: Precise and deadly. Rarely misses his targets.
Arminius - The Warlord: A brute warrior. Each blow can be your demise.


Added 9 new titles suggested by the community:

“Meat Bag” – by willsama974.
“The Great Potato”- by Special Ed.
“Rider of Unicorns” – by ThaBaws.
“The Fierce” – by ThaBaws.
“Raised by kittens” – by ThaBaws.
“The one and only” - by ThaBaws.
“Son of god” - by ThaBaws.
“The Uncontrolled” - by ThaBaws.
“Dog Breath” - by RabidUrko.


Gameplay:

Ranged distance penalty and reward:

1 grid between warriors – 10% hit chance bonus.
2 grids between warriors – 5% hit chance bonus.
3 – 5 grids between warriors – No change to hit chance.
6 grids between warriors – 4% hit chance penalty.
7 grids and above – additional 4% hit chance penalty per grid.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed issue where switching a weapon with “Slight of Hand” skill would result in skipping your turn.

Graphics:

Filled “The Crucible” Arena with crowd above the gates.
Locked tabs in character screen are now more clear.
Rocks in the arena no longer hide the combat grid.
Changed “Confirmation Dialog” graphics.
Inventory starting weapon is now more visible.
Shops and inventory buttons are now more visible

Sounds:

Added tournament victory sound


As usual, please give us your feedback about the local multiplayer balance and additional features you would like to see in the future. 

Until next time, stay vigilent brave warriors!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.402 & Compensation for lost progress
notes.notes:
Greetings Warriors!

As some of you may experienced during our latest patch we accidentally erased all previous progress made in the game.

After crying like babies for 6 hours and hitting ourselves with wooden sticks, we have finally come up with a solution to compensate those of you who have lost their progress during the patch.


In case your character passed the first tournament before the patch, you will receive additional 20 Soul shards to your current character.

In case your character passed the second tournament before the patch, you will receive additional 30 Soul shards to your current character.

In case your character passed the second tournament before the patch, you will receive additional 60 Soul shards to your current character.

And now for the patch changes.

0.4.0.2 Hotfix notes:
Graphics

Arenas background have been fixed.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed issue where kicking “Dead Ned” into a fire trap would cause the game to freeze. (again...)
Fixed issue where the “Dirty Shot” stun caused the game to freeze (we guess that really hurt).
Fixed issue where an arrow was making a deflect sound when a warrior dodges it.


That's all for now, keep letting us know of any bugs and other suggestions and once again, we apologize for any inconvenience caused.

In case your character passed the second tournament before the patch, you will receive additional 30 Soul shards to your current character.

In case your character passed the second tournament before the patch, you will receive additional 60 Soul shards to your current character.

notes.title: Early Access is finally here! Update 0.4 is up!
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow warriors!

It has been a long and bumpy road, but we are happy to finally announce:
This Friday, the 02.02.18 the game will be published in it's early access phase and will be open for the public to purchase!
We want to thank you, our gamers who supported us along the road. Thank you for all the input and feedback, the great words which gave us motivation to keep going and all the players who believed in us and pre-ordered the game.

Thanks to you, we have added content and tuned the game's balance.
Update 0.4 is up and by so this is going to be the early access build.

This is only the beginning, we will keep on updating and expending the game,
but for that we are going to need your feedback. Every opinion matters!

Update 0.4 Changes:

New Features

Introducing “Battle Dice”! – a mini game you can play in the tavern between your arena combats where you can earn extra coins! ($$$)
Give your warriors their own unique titles! 
Warriors now has Steam cards!
Many new sounds have been added to the game.
End game screen – Players who will finish the game will be forever remembered in our future hall of fame.

Changes

You can now skip the post-combat sequence.
Text bubbles appear less frequently.
Additional information in the spoils of war tooltip
Trying to sell a recently bought item will now show a confirmation dialog. 
Maximum heritage coins cannot exceed your slain warrior’s pre-tax coins. 
Forfeiting a combat will now result in losing the fight and leaving your fate in the hands of your opponent.
Enemies with a higher level than your warrior will challenge you only when you are about to level up.
Enemies are now aware of traps, careful not to get pushed to them.
When a warrior is hurt from “Spiked Defense” skill, he will no longer trigger a hurt animation.
When your warrior dies, he will leave one of his items to your next warrior.
Dead Ned’s cutscenes has been improved.

Graphics

Skills triggered during combat now have their own effect.
Tournament fallen enemies are now more distinguished.
When you reach 100% crowd excitement in the tournament, they will throw roses at you!
The cliff is now bigger in the loading screen.
The arena darkens when you receive a soul point.

Balance

The cliff boss has been balanced.
Enemies in level 3 now have less money for items.
“Eye of the tiger” skill is no longer triggered by kick attack.
“Strapped up” skill is a now a level 3 skill, and give you a bonus of 1,2 and 4 arrows instead of 6 arrows.
“Rapid Shooter“ skill is now level 5 skill and has a 35% chance to trigger.
“Professional Bargainer” skill now gives a discount of 5%, 10% and 20% at the shops.
Dead Ned can no longer use Kick.
Buffs from the crowd now appear less frequently 
Warriors Calculated Health formula has been improved.
Enemies in the first tournament have less coins to purchase items.

Technical

Game engine has been optimized and will now run at better frame rate.
Loading times have been shortened.

Bug Fixes

Fixed issue where the volume levels were resetting between duels.
Skeleton avatar eye particles have been fixed.
Fixed issue where the experience and soul bar tooltips were getting cut out of the screen.
Warrior’s speech volume has been raised.
Fixed issue where the price of an item would show incorrectly.
Fixed issue with sound tab in options.
Victory sound level balance.
Starting weapon selector now works better.
Fixed crowd money tooltip.
Fixed dancing music issues.
Combat indicators no longer have an offset.
Warrior defeat cutscenes have been synced with sound.
Crowd buffs that are in combat will now show properly.

notes.title: Update 0.37 is out!
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow warriors!
We have just released update 0.37, and it includes many cool features and changes!


We are happy to announce that this will be the last update before the exciting Early Access launch. Please keep in mind that this is a pre-beta version, so you may encounter some technical issues and bugs. 
if you ecnounter any technical issues, please leave us know in the forums.

We are working around the clock on developing and improving the game, so please let know in the forums about your gameplay experience, what you liked and didn't like and what would you like to see next in our game,
To make it as enjoyable and fun as we can for you, The gamers!

So have fun and good luck in the arena!

Version 0.37 Changes:

New Features:

    Skill tree! You can now unlock skills that fit you fighting style!
    New tournament mode - Will you be the champion?
    New tattoos options
    Added "Dead Ned" the skeleton boss
    New fire trap
    Steam achievements!
    level cap is now 8


Other changes:
 Prices, items, enemies and combat is more balance now. Let us know how you feel about it.
 Main Menu has been revamped
 Many, Many bug fixes and polish
